decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core seasonal craft offer, and demand for home décor was strong during 2020-2021, so it likely still meets aspirations and gives no trigger for problemistic search, though its featured status has faded after several years.
A one-tier pyramid is the firm's established core product type and runs on existing workshop routines at low cost, so it likely performs at aspiration and is kept.

The firm presented the music box line as its strategic flagship, and slack from growing turnover lets management carry a distant product whose results are still uncertain rather than abandon its commitment, though the lack of observations since 2018 raises some doubt.

This minor, distant accessory had low visibility and its sister platform was already dropped, which makes withdrawal fairly likely, but its tie to the flagship music box and low resource demands still favor keeping it for now.
